detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name: Modular Peptide System C – Controlled-Rheology Peptide Emulsion

Module Classification: Precision Module

Product Information:

  • Formulation Type: Low-Viscosity Peptide Emulsion
  • Volume: 15 mL
  • pH Range: 5.2–5.8
  • Packaging: Opaque Airless UV-Protective Container
  • Testing Methodology: HPLC-UV-MS
  • Analytical Verification: ISO/IEC 17025 Accredited Laboratory
  • System Compatibility: Phase 1, Complete Configuration, Standalone Evaluation

Analytical Composition:

  • Dipeptide-2: 0.40%
  • Acetyl Tetrapeptide-5: 0.07%
  • Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7: 0.05%
  • Caffeine: 0.30%
  • Total Peptide Content: 0.52%

Product Description:

Module C is one of five products within PHP’s Modular Peptide System, a modular framework of peptide formulations designed for research evaluation. Researchers may evaluate individual modules independently or as part of three structured configurations: Phase 1, Phase 2, or the Complete Configuration.

Module C is a peptide-based low-viscosity emulsion with controlled rheology, designed for positional stability and localized evaluation. The formulation was engineered as the ocular-region component of the Topical System framework, incorporating a confined-evaluation matrix distinct from the broader-scope compositions used elsewhere in the system. The composition integrates three peptides drawn from three distinct structural classes, with caffeine serving as a non-peptide supporting component.

Composition is independently verified through ISO/IEC 17025-accredited analytical testing using HPLC-UV-MS methodology. Batch-specific Certificates of Analysis are available through the COA-Topicals library.

Research Framework:

  • Highest total peptide concentration within the modular framework
  • Three-peptide composition spanning three structural classes
  • Includes both peptide and non-peptide supporting components
  • Localized evaluation architecture
  • Compatible with Phase 1 and Complete Configuration
  • May be evaluated independently or as part of broader comparative frameworks

Formulation Characteristics:

  • Dipeptide-2 serves as the primary peptide component at 0.40%
  • Acetyl Tetrapeptide-5 and Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7 function as supporting peptides
  • Caffeine incorporated as a non-peptide supporting component
  • Controlled rheology engineered through carbomer neutralization
  • Designed to provide a defined yield value and positional stability during evaluation
  • Narrower pH range than other modules due to the rheological system requirements
  • Airless packaging supports compositional integrity and minimizes environmental exposure

Comparative Position Within The System:

Within the modular framework, Module C functions as the precision composition and is the only module specifically engineered for confined evaluation contexts rather than broader-scope evaluation. With a total peptide content of 0.52%, it represents the highest peptide concentration product within the system and introduces three distinct peptide classes within a single formulation.

Product Specifications:

  • Primary Peptide: Dipeptide-2
  • Total Peptide Content: 0.52%
  • Supporting Component: Caffeine (0.30%)
  • Peptide Classes: Three
  • Delivery Matrix: Low-Viscosity Controlled-Rheology Emulsion
  • Packaging: Opaque Airless UV-Protective
  • Batch Verification: ISO/IEC 17025 HPLC-UV-MS

Compliance Notice:

Modular Peptide System C is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY — NOT FOR HUMAN OR VETERINARY USE. This product is not a drug, cosmetic, food, or dietary supplement and has not been evaluated or approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. It is intended solely for lawful in vitro research and not for any human or animal use. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used exclusively for lawful in vitro research in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, and assumes all responsibility for any use inconsistent with this notice.
